usage: Evaluation-only synthetic phrases; not operational facts or YOLO training data. Human review is always required.

common_user_phrases: Someone is missing; can we review the last reported location?
scenarios.limitations: A detection cannot identify a missing person.

common_user_phrases: Several vehicles have stopped on the road.
possible_operator_questions: Is anyone injured and what location is confirmed?
scenarios.limitations: A stopped vehicle does not establish a collision.

common_user_phrases: There is a crowd gathering near the gate.
possible_operator_questions: Can an operator verify the scene and route access?
scenarios.limitations: Crowd formation is not established by a single-frame person detector.

common_user_phrases: People are moving quickly near the entrance.
possible_operator_questions: What can the operator actually observe?
scenarios.limitations: Movement does not establish a disturbance or intent.

common_user_phrases: There is a bag near the entrance; can someone check it?
possible_operator_questions: Can a person verify whether it is unattended?
scenarios.limitations: Community account unverified; a bag is not evidence of danger or ownership.

common_user_phrases: A bike entered the restricted lane.
possible_operator_questions: Is the zone configured and the event independently verified?
scenarios.limitations: Current detector alone does not establish crossing or a violation.

common_user_phrases: A vehicle may have entered a restricted lane.
possible_operator_questions: Can an operator verify the road rule and footage?
scenarios.limitations: Object detection alone does not establish a traffic violation.

common_user_phrases: Someone appears to be lying on the road.
possible_operator_questions: Has a witness confirmed whether medical help is needed?
scenarios.limitations: Posture and medical status are not validated detector outputs.

common_user_phrases: There may be smoke near the building.
possible_operator_questions: Can the report and location be verified?
scenarios.limitations: Current YOLO deployment is not validated for smoke or fire.

common_user_phrases: A witness reports a possible theft.
possible_operator_questions: What did the witness report, and has it been verified?
scenarios.limitations: Crime is a reported case type, never an automatic visual conclusion.
